title: Design Better (Aarron Walter & Eli Woolery) — 'doing the right thing 100% of the time is easier than 98%'
summary: Walter and Woolery host the Design Better Podcast at The Curiosity Department, where they run long-form conversations about creative work. Eric was their guest for a 50-minute episode pitched at designers: the company itself is the most important product you will ever design.
blockquote: the late great Klay Christensen said he said right before he died, it is easier to do the right thing 100% of the time than 98% of the time. And a huge amount of modern business is having these total meetings about what is the ROI of doing the right thing. And the nice thing about having a principle that we always do the right thing is we don't have to have the meeting.
attribution_title: Hosts, Design Better Podcast (The Curiosity Department)
